name: diff
title: Diff
description: Diff what you copied: the two newest copies in the clipboard history, the clipboard against the selection, any two history entries, or two files, as a view with the changed lines tinted and the words that differ marked. Unified or side by side, whitespace ignored on a key, long unchanged runs folded, the unified diff a copy away, the two sides open in VS Code, kitty, FileMerge or Meld.
author: pal

settings.label: External tool
settings.description: What `o` opens the two sides in. Auto takes the first installed of VS Code (`code --diff`), kitty (`+kitten diff`), FileMerge (`opendiff`, with Xcode) and Meld.

settings.label: Custom command
settings.description: With the custom tool: the command line, `{left}` and `{right}` standing for the two files (a quoted argument stays whole).

store.tagline: Diff the two things you just copied
features: Open it and the two newest text copies are diffed, the older on the left: what changed on the way to the newer one
Other pairs on a key: `e` the clipboard against the selection in the app in front, `h` two entries picked from the history (or marked there), `f` two files typed into a form
Line by line with the words that differ marked inside a changed line, line numbers for both sides, a pair that differs in whitespace alone tagged
Unified by default, side by side on `s`; `w` ignores whitespace; `x` swaps the sides
Long unchanged runs fold to one row; `tab` walks the folds, `space` or a click expands one, `a` all
Enter copies the unified diff (`--- left`, `+++ right`, the hunks), `l` and `r` the left and right text
`o` opens the two sides in VS Code, kitty, FileMerge, Meld or a command of your own

`pal://diff/clipboard`, `pal://diff/selection`, `pal://diff/files?left=&right=`, `pal://diff/text?left=&right=` for keybinds and scripts; the Clipboard History palette's Diff with… and Diff these two land here
